verdict.rationale: The repo ships an official `skill-creator` meta-skill, documented as "a skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them." It also benchmarks skill performance with variance analysis and optimizes descriptions for triggering accuracy, and the repo includes a template SKILL.md. A runtime probe confirmed skill-creator installs cleanly as a standalone skill. missing for 10: evidence that the meta-skill itself guides packaging/distribution (packaging is documented only separately via plugins and marketplaces), hands-on corroboration of the authoring and improvement loop actually working.
